- Zn+2 forms Zn(OH)2 (white, amphoteric - dissolves in excess NH3)
- Mg+2 forms Mg(OH)2 (white)
- Pb+2 forms Pb(OH)2 (white)

The yellowish orange color strongly suggests HgO, which means Hg+2 is present!
